name: ai-accelerator
description: AI Accelerator — brandless starter template for the Diriyah Company AI team, built by Orion Digital Solutions: Next.js web (BFF) + FastAPI api (SQLAlchemy 2 async + Alembic), with end-to-end trace_id propagation and Azure Monitor OpenTelemetry observability.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n web,api -c green,magenta "pnpm -C apps/web dev" "uv run --directory apps/api uvicorn app.main:app --reload --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000"
scripts.fmt: prettier --write . && uvx ruff@0.15.16 format apps/api && uvx ruff@0.15.16 check --fix apps/api
